text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap achieved splendid results in the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then I want to prepare something fitting 
for this milestone. I had planned a 
certain event for Oguri Cap, who gave us 
the greatest dream of all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer... Where am I even headed 
right now?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Being told not to open my eyes... It makes 
me kind of nervous.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Is that so? In that case—

text_block_list.name: Roar of the Crowd
text_block_list.text: Oguri! Oguri! Oguri! Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh... W-What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crowds upon crowds upon crowds... A 
massive crowd had gathered at the 
racecourse, and they were all chanting 
Oguri Cap's name!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ogurii! Great job in the race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Kyaa, Ogurin! You were so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. What on earth is this...
choice_data_list: Everyone came here to see you, Oguri.
Everyone came here to see you, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Did everyone... gather here for my sake? 
So many of you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap, who kept on running for the 
sake of the people supporting her. What 
can I possibly do for her sake?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What would make Oguri Cap happiest of all? 
When I thought about it, the first thing 
that came to mind was the smiling faces of 
the fans cheering her on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because to Oguri Cap... every single 
person who calls out her name is precious!
choice_data_list: Today's event is for Oguri to enjoy!
Today's event is for Oguri to enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Me...? But, is that really alright?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha! How powerful.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I got it. Today, I'm gonna enjoy 
myself to the absolute fullest!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Oguri Cap enjoyed 
interacting with her fans with all her 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ogurin! Strike the same pose as this 
plushie~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Meaning...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Like this?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: So cute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That's kind of embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Still, it doesn't feel half bad...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Amaaazing! Ogurin is soo fast!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fast. After all, I am an 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Would you like to try running 
along with me?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: "Huh, really!? I wanna run with Ogurin!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course. Alright then, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~!? Ogurin, wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And we even have a special guest...!

text_block_list.name: Take-san
text_block_list.text: Oguri-chan! We're here~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone...! You came for me!

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text:
That Trainer over there called out to me, 
so I hopped right on the Shinkansen and 
zipped over here!

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
I brought the rice balls that you love so 
much, Oguri-chan!

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
We're going to enjoy ourselves as fans 
today too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, you guys are really hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, Inari, and even Creek...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's Oguri's big moment! There's no way 
we're gonna miss it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If there's anything you need help with, 
I'm happy to assist. Please don't hesitate 
to rely on me♪"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you...! Truly, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And finally, at Oguri Cap's earnest 
request, it was decided we would hold a 
live show...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for today. ...No, not 
just for today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
When I came to the Central, completely 
lost and knowing nothing... you guided me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Though I could only move slowly, they 
walked with me patiently.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And then, before I even realized it, 
things had gotten this out of hand—

text_block_list.name: Roar of the Crowd
text_block_list.text: Oguri! Oguri! Oguri! Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“—To think so many people have come to 
cheer for me now.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you... glad that I was the one 
you took charge of?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Cheering for me all this time... was it 
fun?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —There was only one answer!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep showing them the dream. As long 
as everyone's here cheering for us...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running. —For your sake, 
who gave me your love!
